programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programs.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programs.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programs.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programs.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Chicago"
programs.desc: CGI strips Chicago’s Willis Tower and L-rail to reveal how green roofs, deep tunnels, and heat-proofed bridges protect 10 million citizens.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programs.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programs.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programs.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."
